    It's Either Ben-Gvir as Minister or Israeli Democracy

    Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara could not have been clearer Wednesday when she asked the Supreme Court to order the dismissal of National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir. Her request followed the court's issuance last month of a show-cause order requiring Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to explain why he hasn't fired Ben-Gvir, given High Court petitions detailing the minister's unacceptable political intervention in the police's work.
